rows.reason: A third-tone run crosses tokens; 想 + 你好 is verb + object, so 想 lowers (2 3 2 2 3).
老总 + 好看 is a three-syllable unit (word + syllable), so 总 lowers (2 2 3 4).
A repeated character follows the same 2 2 3 unit as any three-syllable word; the revision-2 raw-repeat exemption is gone.
The reader marks the second 说 neutral after tone 1, so layer 2 gives it the grave (shuò).
The installed pack reads 个 ge4 instead of the neutral ge5; a full tone 4 is written grave (kừa).
The installed pack reads 喝 he1 instead of the neutral he5; tone 1 is unmarked (hưa).
友 is neutral with real tone 3 and a full vowel, so it takes the hook after tone 2.
现 (4) before 在 (4) is written flat across tokens.
种 (3) before 解 (3) is a pair across the token boundary, so 种 lowers (zhóng).
地 is read dì here (the token is not tagged uv), and dì (4) before chàng (4) is flat (ti).
